name: Quadruped Robot Controller
summary: A dedicated controller for quadruped robots, integrating an eight-core Arm processor, 6 TOPS AI compute and a real-time operating system. It provides Ethernet, wireless connectivity and serial interfaces for robot peripherals.

description.en: A dedicated controller for quadruped robots, integrating an eight-core Arm processor, 6 TOPS AI compute and a real-time operating system. It provides Ethernet, wireless connectivity and serial interfaces for robot peripherals.

specs.label: Ai compute
specs.conditions: Configuration: Quadruped Robot Controller; Manufacturer table configuration. Supported peripherals are not claimed as included hardware; AI compute range has no finer mode mapping.
